LabeledField.description: A labelled text input. Bind `value` to a data path and the field writes what the user types there. Attach `checks` and the message of the first failing rule is shown under the field.

value.description: What the field currently holds. The component writes the value the user chooses back to this property, so bind it to a data path if you need to read the result.

MetricsTable.description: A titled table of metrics. Each row has a label, a numeric value, a trend (up, down or flat) and an optional note. Use it to compare several KPIs at once, for example a quarterly summary or the health of a set of services.

title.description: The heading shown above the table, e.g. "Q3 performance".

rows.description: The rows of the table, in display order.

items.description: One row of a metrics table: a labelled metric with its current value, the direction it is moving in and an optional short note explaining the number.

label.description: A short caption naming the metric, e.g. "Monthly revenue".

value.description: The current numeric value of the metric.

trend.description: Whether the metric went up, down or stayed flat.

note.description: An optional one-line comment about this row, e.g. "vs. last quarter".

anyOf.description: A JSON Pointer path to a value in the data model.
Invokes a named function on the client.

Panel.description: A titled panel that wraps any other component. It has a header with the title and a close button, a body and an optional row of action components (typically buttons) along the bottom edge. Use it to group related content under a heading.

title.description: The heading shown at the top of the panel.

child.description: The component rendered as the body of the panel.

actions.description: Components laid out along the bottom edge, usually buttons.

items.description: The unique identifier for a component.

onClose.description: Fired when the user presses the close button in the header.

meta.description: Extra labelled details, shown under the title. The keys are the agent's to choose: this is for whatever it decided was worth attaching to this particular panel, which is exactly the case a fixed set of properties cannot express.

anyOf.description: A JSON Pointer path to a value in the data model.
Invokes a named function on the client.

PreferenceRow.description: One preference the user can turn on or off, with a label and an optional line of explanation. Use it when you need the user to answer yes or no and you want to read the answer back: bind `enabled` to a data path, and the switch writes the new state there.

label.description: A short caption naming the preference, e.g. "Weekly summary".

enabled.description: Whether the preference is currently on. The component writes the value the user chooses back to this property, so bind it to a data path if you need to read the result.

detail.description: One line of explanation shown under the label.

ProductCard.description: A card that presents a single product with its name, price in USD and an optional image. Use it to show one item of a catalog or a search result. Tapping the card fires its onTap action.

title.description: The product name shown as the card headline.

imageUrl.description: An optional URL of an image shown above the title.

onTap.description: Fired when the user taps the card.

StatTile.description: A compact tile that shows one numeric metric (a KPI) with a label and a trend indicator: up, down or flat. Use it to summarize a statistic such as revenue, active users or conversion rate.

label.description: A short caption naming the metric, e.g. "Monthly revenue".

value.description: The current numeric value of the metric.

trend.description: Whether the metric went up, down or stayed flat.

anyOf.description: A JSON Pointer path to a value in the data model.
Invokes a named function on the client.

history.description: Recent values of the metric, oldest first, drawn as a sparkline under the number. Leave it out for a tile with no history.

anyOf.description: A JSON Pointer path to a value in the data model.
Invokes a named function on the client.

TagRow.description: A row of short text tags rendered as chips. Exactly one tag is highlighted as selected. Use it to show categories, filters or keywords attached to an item.

tags.description: The tags to display, one chip each, in order.

selectedIndex.description: The zero-based index of the highlighted tag. Defaults to the first one.

TaskList.description: A titled list of rows, one per item in the data.

emptyLabel.description: Shown when there are no rows.

describeMetric.description: Describes one metric in a sentence, for a tooltip or a summary line. Takes the same row object the tables take.

anyOf.description: One row of a metrics table: a labelled metric with its current value, the direction it is moving in and an optional short note explaining the number.

label.description: A short caption naming the metric, e.g. "Monthly revenue".

value.description: The current numeric value of the metric.

trend.description: Whether the metric went up, down or stayed flat.

note.description: An optional one-line comment about this row, e.g. "vs. last quarter".

anyOf.description: A JSON Pointer path to a value in the data model.
Invokes a named function on the client.

formatPrice.description: Formats a number of cents as a price string, so the agent never has to do currency arithmetic itself.

currency.description: Represents a string that can be static, bound, or computed.

shortenName.description: Shortens a full name for display. Use it when a surface has room for a name but not the whole one, such as a table cell or an avatar.

name.description: Represents a string that can be static, bound, or computed.

Invokes a named function on the client.
